solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Notices Fleet Street boss introducing a thousand retrograde working areas (8)

indicatorNotes.introducing: the notices take the thousand into themselves
indicatorNotes.retrograde: moving backwards, so the whole string is read right to left

blocks.note: to spot = to notice
K = a thousand, from kilo; it goes inside SPOTS before the final S
the editor; Fleet Street is the old home of London newspapers

annotation.surface: A newspaper editor pins up notices while a thousand backward-looking staff sit at their workstations.
annotation.walkthrough: SPOT(K)S + ED makes SPOTKSED, which reads DESKTOPS backwards. Fleet Street is the London street where the national papers used to be based.
annotation.definitionFit: Desktops are the surfaces, physical or on screen, where work is laid out.

entries.clue: Reject is in blue (6)

indicatorNotes.in: IS sits inside the word for blue

blocks.note: feeling blue = feeling down
used as it stands, placed inside D…OWN

annotation.surface: A rejected applicant is left feeling blue.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Blue' is the mood here, not the colour.
annotation.definitionFit: To disown someone is to reject them as your own.

entries.clue: Quiet voice is closer (7)

blocks.note: the call for quiet
to voice = to utter

annotation.surface: Someone lowers their voice as they lean in closer.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Closer' looks like 'nearer' but is read as a thing that closes, like a window shutter.
annotation.definitionFit: A shutter is what closes over a window or camera lens.

entries.clue: A celebrant running place of worship (10)

indicatorNotes.running: the letters of A CELEBRANT are set in motion and rearranged

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 10 letters

annotation.surface: A priest is in charge of a church.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Running' reads as managing the place, which is why it hides as an anagram signal.
annotation.definitionFit: A tabernacle is a place of worship, originally the portable sanctuary of the Israelites.

entries.clue: Declaiming in a way fitting Pacino (13)

indicatorNotes.in a way: the letters are arranged in another way

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 13 letters

annotation.surface: Grand speechifying is just the style that suits Al Pacino.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a comment on Pacino's big-speech acting; 'in a way' is the only signal that the next two words are to be rearranged.
annotation.definitionFit: To pontificate is to hold forth pompously, much like declaiming.

entries.clue: Tell where truant should be? (6)

blocks.note: in class with the rest of the pupils, read as two words

annotation.surface: Someone is asked to report where a pupil skipping school should be.
annotation.walkthrough: In British schools a form is a class or year group, so a truant should be IN FORM. The question mark flags the playful second reading.
annotation.definitionFit: Both senses: to inform is a plain synonym for tell, and split in two it is where a pupil belongs during lessons.

entries.clue: Demonstrating skill catching article in trap (4)

indicatorNotes.catching: the trap catches the article, holding it inside

blocks.note: a net is a trap
the indefinite article, caught inside NE…T

annotation.surface: A trapper shows skill by catching something in a trap.
annotation.walkthrough: 'In' belongs to the surface: the trap is the word that does the catching.
annotation.definitionFit: A neat piece of work is one done with skill.

entries.clue: Round wild ass up that might go into stew? (7)

indicatorNotes.up: in a down clue, the word is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: a round letter
the onager is a wild ass of Asia

annotation.surface: Someone rounds up a wild donkey, wondering whether it could end up in a stew.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition is by example, hence the question mark: oregano is one thing that might go into a stew. The surface wants the ass itself in the pot.
annotation.definitionFit: Oregano is a herb commonly added to stews.

entries.clue: Insect that flies low across southern desert (8)

indicatorNotes.across: the word for low stretches across, surrounding the rest

blocks.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do
S = southern
to desert = to quit

annotation.surface: An insect skims low over a desert in the south.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Flies low' reads as one phrase, but the break comes after 'flies': 'low' is the sound cattle make, not a height.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain definition with a tag: 'that flies' is added because the surface needs the verb, and the mosquito is a winged, biting fly.

entries.clue: Low-value coin market finally dropped (3)

indicatorNotes.finally: points to the last letter of the market word

blocks.note: a souk is an Arab market; its final letter is the one dropped

annotation.surface: A cheap coin finally falls out of use at market.
annotation.walkthrough: The sou was an old French coin of very small value.
annotation.definitionFit: A sou was a small French coin, and the word still means next to no money.

entries.clue: Obese shrank with exercise bicycles (11)

indicatorNotes.with exercise: the letters are put through a workout and come out rearranged

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 11 letters

annotation.surface: An overweight person lost size by working out on exercise bikes.
annotation.walkthrough: Boneshakers were early bicycles with iron tyres and no suspension, so named for the ride they gave.
annotation.definitionFit: Boneshaker is the old name for the rigid-framed nineteenth-century bicycle.

entries.clue: Delight in misfortune a chef’s endured cooking (13)

indicatorNotes.cooking: the letters are cooked up into a new arrangement

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 13 letters

annotation.surface: Someone takes pleasure in the disasters a chef has suffered in the kitchen.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is its own example: enjoying a chef's kitchen woes is schadenfreude.
annotation.definitionFit: Schadenfreude, borrowed from German, is pleasure taken in another's misfortune.

entries.clue: Beyond doubt drunk on Adam’s ale (10)

indicatorNotes.on: the word for drunk is placed after the water

blocks.note: Adam's ale is an old joke name for water, the only drink Adam had
tight = drunk

annotation.surface: Someone is certainly drunk, but only on water.
annotation.walkthrough: Getting drunk on water is the absurd picture; 'on' is the placement.
annotation.definitionFit: A figurative sense: something that lets no water in lets no doubt in either, so an argument with no gaps is beyond doubt.

entries.clue: Form of drug university prohibited (4)

blocks.note: a tab is a tablet, one form a drug comes in
U = university

annotation.surface: A university has banned some form of drug.
annotation.walkthrough: TABU is a variant spelling of taboo.
annotation.definitionFit: Taboo, spelt tabu, means forbidden.

entries.clue: Bet about chest one exposed is quite bare (5-5)

indicatorNotes.about: the word for bet goes around the rest
indicatorNotes.exposed: ONE is stripped of its outer letters, leaving its middle

blocks.note: to bet = to stake, here in the past tense
an ark is a chest, as in the Ark of the Covenant
ONE without its outside letters

annotation.surface: Someone has wagered that a person baring their chest is nearly naked.
annotation.walkthrough: ST(ARK + N)AKED. 'Exposed' fits the nudity picture but works as an instruction to strip a word.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: 'stark' works as an intensifier, like 'quite', so the phrase means wholly unclothed.

entries.clue: Sheep heads in any rich goulash are largely inedible (6)

indicatorNotes.heads in: take the head, or first letter, of each following word

blocks.clueFragment: any rich goulash are largely inedible
blocks.note: the first letter of each of the six words, in order

annotation.surface: Sheep's heads in a rich stew are mostly uneatable.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Sheep heads' reads as a dish; 'heads' belongs instead with 'in'.
annotation.definitionFit: The argali is a large wild sheep of central Asia.

entries.clue: Rubbish US has left around old metropolis there (7)

indicatorNotes.has left: US departs from the rubbish word

blocks.note: detritus = rubbish; with US gone, DETRIT is left
the letters removed
O = old, placed inside DETR…IT

annotation.surface: America has abandoned an old city to decay.
annotation.walkthrough: 'There' points back to the US in the clue: the answer is a metropolis in America.
annotation.definitionFit: Detroit is a major city in the United States.

entries.clue: Hackneyed revues do badly (8)

indicatorNotes.badly: the letters are put together wrongly

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 8 letters

annotation.surface: Tired old stage revues flop.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a review of stale variety shows, which is the answer's meaning too.
annotation.definitionFit: Hackneyed and overused both describe material worn out by repetition.

entries.clue: Very deep blue large American orchid (7)

blocks.note: V = very
anil is indigo, the plant and its deep blue dye
L = large, as in clothing sizes
A = American

annotation.surface: A large American orchid has flowers of a very deep blue.
annotation.walkthrough: Vanilla is the pod of a climbing orchid, which makes the plain-looking definition fair.
annotation.definitionFit: Vanilla comes from the seed pods of a tropical orchid.

entries.clue: What envelops many in the dark close to moor (7)

annotation.definition: What envelops many in the dark

blocks.note: nigh = close, near
to moor a boat is to tie it up

annotation.surface: Something shrouds the crowds in the gloom near the moorland.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Close to moor' reads as a place beside a moor, but the phrase splits after 'close'. The definition is a riddle about bedtime, not darkness outdoors.
annotation.definitionFit: A nightie is a nightdress, worn by many in the dark hours.

entries.clue: New shaft is cramped (6)

blocks.note: N = new
an arrow's body is its shaft

annotation.surface: A newly dug mine shaft is too tight.
annotation.walkthrough: The mining picture makes 'shaft' a tunnel; here it is the arrow.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both describe a space with too little room across it.

entries.clue: Paintings family’s giving protection from damp (7)

blocks.note: oil paintings, oils for short
kin = family

annotation.surface: A family's paintings are being kept safe from damp.
annotation.walkthrough: The 's reads as 'is': oils + kin is giving the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: An oilskin is a waterproofed cloth or coat.

entries.clue: Henry and Edward called it a day (6)

blocks.note: Hal is a pet form of Henry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal
Ted is a pet form of Edward

annotation.surface: Two men named Henry and Edward stopped work for the day.
annotation.walkthrough: The names look like kings in a history lesson; they are just their short forms.
annotation.definitionFit: To call it a day is to stop, to halt.

entries.clue: City of God, is initially good to enter (4)

indicatorNotes.initially: take the first letters of 'is' and 'good'
indicatorNotes.to enter: those letters go inside the god

blocks.note: Ra, the Egyptian sun god
first letters of 'is' and 'good', entering R…A

annotation.surface: Entering the City of God is a good thing.
annotation.walkthrough: 'City of God' looks like one phrase, but the definition is just 'City'.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the capital of Latvia is one instance of a city.

entries.clue: Repellent edited clone trial (10)

indicatorNotes.edited: the letters are altered, as a text is by an editor

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 10 letters

annotation.surface: A gene-edited cloning experiment is found repugnant.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Repellent' reads as the adjective 'disgusting'; the answer is the noun, an insect repellent.
annotation.definitionFit: Citronella oil is a widely used insect repellent.

entries.clue: Video coverage of little significance (4)

blocks.note: a recorded moving picture, or the act of recording one
a thin, slight covering layer, as of dust or oil

annotation.surface: Some video footage turns out to be unimportant.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Coverage' suggests news reporting, but here it is a thin covering layer.
annotation.definitionFit: Film means both a recorded movie and a very thin coating.

entries.clue: Easy game, smart holding it with zero score (7,4)

indicatorNotes.holding: the word for smart holds IT inside
indicatorNotes.with: the zero score is added on after

blocks.note: to smart = to sting
used as it stands, held inside S…TING
in cricket a duck is a score of zero

annotation.surface: A clever side leads an easy match with the opposition yet to score.
annotation.walkthrough: S(IT)TING + DUCK. 'Game' is the hunted kind: a sitting duck is an easy target.
annotation.definitionFit: A sitting duck is an easy target, game that is simple to hit.

entries.clue: One in knight’s apparel (3)

indicatorNotes.in: the one goes inside the knight's abbreviation

blocks.note: Kt is the abbreviation for knight
I = one, as a Roman numeral, placed inside K…T

annotation.surface: An item in a knight's outfit.
annotation.walkthrough: Kit is British English for clothing or gear, as in football kit.
annotation.definitionFit: Kit means clothing or outfit.

entries.clue: Finally counted one’s last boring sheep in bedtime thoughts (6)

indicatorNotes.boring: that E drills into the sheep

blocks.note: last letter of counted
rams are male sheep
last letter of one, boring into R…AMS

annotation.surface: Counting sheep until the last one is too dull, a sleeper drifts off.
annotation.walkthrough: D + R(E)AMS. 'Boring' reads as dull, the point of counting sheep, but it means drilling into.
annotation.definitionFit: A loose descriptive definition: what passes through the mind once asleep, the reward for counting sheep.

entries.clue: Muffled echo in closed passage (8)

indicatorNotes.in: the echo goes inside the passage

blocks.note: a dead end is a passage closed at one end
Echo is E in the radio alphabet, going in one letter from the end

annotation.surface: An echo sounds dull inside a sealed corridor.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Echo' belongs to the acoustic picture, but it is just the letter E.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to deaden a sound is to dull or muffle it.
